get.summary: Name, version and environment of the running API.
Smoke test that runs a query through the full application pipeline.

post.summary: Staff sign-in with email or user name and password (plus a 2FA code when enabled).
Exchange a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token (rotation with reuse detection).
End this session. Works with the refresh token even when the access token has expired.
End every session of the signed-in user.

get.summary: Profile, branches, roles per branch and effective permissions of the signed-in user.
Does the signed-in staff member hold this permission in the active branch (X-Branch-Id)? For hiding buttons in the UI.

post.summary: Change the password. All other sessions end; a new session is returned.
Email a password-reset link. Always answers 202, so it cannot reveal which emails have accounts.
Set a new password with the emailed token. All sessions end.

get.summary: Devices signed in as me.

delete.summary: Sign one of my devices out.

post.summary: Send a one-time password by SMS to a mobile number.
Verify the code; creates the quick profile on first use and signs the customer in.
Get the authenticator key and otpauth URI to scan.
Turn two-step verification on with a code from the app. Returns one-time recovery codes.
Turn two-step verification off (not allowed for Super Admin).
Replace the recovery codes.

get.summary: List staff users.

post.summary: Create a staff user. A temporary password is returned once when none is given; the user must change it.

get.summary: User details with branch roles.

put.summary: Edit name, phone and global scope.

post.summary: Activate an account.
Deactivate an account at once (history is kept).
Set a new temporary password and end all sessions.
End all sessions of a user.
Turn off a user's two-step verification (lost phone).

get.summary: Active sessions of a user.

delete.summary: End one session of a user.

get.summary: Sign-in history of a user.
What a user can do, per branch.
Branch and role assignments of a user.

post.summary: Give a user a role in a branch (or everywhere for global users).

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user in a branch.

get.summary: The permission catalog grouped by module, with its version.
Search the audit log (who changed what, when, in which branch).
Search sign-in attempts of staff and customers.
List roles.

post.summary: Create a role with a set of permissions.

get.summary: A role with its permissions.

put.summary: Rename a role or change its description (system roles keep their name).

delete.summary: Delete a role that is not a system role and not in use.

post.summary: Copy a role and its permissions under a new name.

put.summary: Replace the permissions of a role. Users of the role get the change within seconds.

post.summary: Create a branch.

put.summary: Edit a branch.

post.summary: Activate a branch.
Deactivate a branch (never the default or the last active one). Users lose access to it at once.
Make a branch the default.

The category tree with product counts.

Set the order of categories by the order of the ids.

delete.summary: Delete a brand that no product uses.

post.summary: Add a size chart.

put.summary: Edit a size chart.

delete.summary: Delete a size chart that no product uses.

get.summary: List products (search by name, slug, SKU or barcode).

post.summary: Create a draft product.

get.summary: A product with variants, images and what still blocks publishing. Cost is empty without catalog.product.view-cost.

put.summary: Edit a product.

delete.summary: Delete a draft or archived product (history is kept).

post.summary: Publish when name, category, price, an image and an active variant exist (BR-B1).
Take a product off the shop (back to draft).
Archive a product.
Copy a product as a draft with new SKUs.
Add a colour/size variant with a unique SKU.

put.summary: Edit a variant.

get.summary: Download the import template (format=csv or xlsx) with the expected columns and example rows.

post.summary: Import products, variants and opening stock from a CSV or Excel file (mode=create|upsert, dryRun=true to only validate). A file with any error saves nothing.

get.summary: Export products and variants (format=csv or xlsx). Pass branchId to include that branch's stock. Cost price only with catalog.product.view-cost.

post.summary: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture (at least 1000 px on the long side, at most 10 MB). WebP renditions, a 4:5 crop and a blur placeholder are made.

put.summary: Set the colour, alt text or focal point of a picture.

delete.summary: Delete a picture and its files.

put.summary: Set the picture order by the order of the ids (the first is the card image).

get.summary: Stock per variant and branch: on hand, reserved, available, threshold. Only branches where you may view stock.
Every variant of a product against every branch you may view (zero where never stocked).

post.summary: Add or remove stock with a reason (opening stock, correction, damage, loss, found, customer return). All lines or none.

put.summary: Set the low-stock threshold of a variant in a branch.

get.summary: The append-only stock ledger, newest first.
Transfers where you may view either branch.

post.summary: Request a transfer (either the sending or the receiving branch may ask).

get.summary: One transfer with its lines and the actions you may take.

post.summary: Approve (source branch). Checks the stock is there.
Reject a requested transfer (source branch).
Ship (source branch): stock leaves the source now.
Receive (destination branch): stock enters the destination.
Cancel before receipt. Goods in transit go back to the source.

get.summary: Stock counts of the branches you may view.

post.summary: Start a count of a branch (all stocked variants, or the variants listed). Snapshots the system quantity.

get.summary: One stock count with its lines and differences.

put.summary: Enter counted quantities (null clears a line).

post.summary: Submit for review.
Send a submitted count back for more counting.
Approve: the differences are booked as stock movements.
Cancel an open count; nothing is booked.

get.summary: Active categories as a tree with the number of published products.
Home page sections: new arrivals, best sellers, featured, on sale, categories.
Published products with filters (category slug, price range, size, colour, brand, inStock, onSale), sort (newest, price-asc, price-desc, popular) and search q (small spelling mistakes are tolerated).
Sizes, colours, brands and price range available in a category, for the filter panel.
One published product by its web address: variants with combined availability, pictures, size chart, related products.
Search suggestions while typing: products and categories.
Countries the shop delivers to.
The divisions of Bangladesh.
Districts of Bangladesh, optionally of one division.
Upazilas of a district.

post.summary: Delivery charge and estimated delivery dates for an address and goods (items, or subtotal and weight). The charge shown is the charge billed.
What a coupon code would give on a subtotal. Rate limited against code guessing.

get.summary: The cart (guest: send X-Cart-Token; signed-in customer: their own cart). An unknown token gives an empty cart.

post.summary: Add a variant. A guest without a token gets a new cart and the answer holds its token (send it as X-Cart-Token from then on). The quantity is checked against what is available now.

put.summary: Set a line's quantity (0 removes it).

post.summary: Apply a coupon code to the cart.
Delivery charge for the cart's goods (after any coupon) to an address.
After sign-in: move the guest cart (its token) into the customer's cart. Quantities are clamped to what is available.

get.summary: My profile.

put.summary: Change my name and email (the mobile number is my identity and cannot be changed here).

get.summary: Counts for the account home: addresses, wishlist, cart items, default address (orders are filled in Step 8).
My consents (marketing SMS, marketing email, privacy policy).

put.summary: Give or withdraw one consent. Each change is logged with its time.

get.summary: My address book, default first.

post.summary: Add an address (Bangladesh: district and optional upazila; abroad: country, city). The first one becomes the default.

put.summary: Change an address.

post.summary: Make this address the default.

get.summary: My wishlist, newest first.

post.summary: Save a product (saving it twice changes nothing).
Put a variant of this product in my cart and take the product off the wishlist.

get.summary: List customers. Mobile and email are masked unless you hold customers.customer.view-pii; unmasked views are audit-logged.
One customer with addresses, consents and sign-in summary (personal data masked without view-pii; unmasked views are audit-logged).

post.summary: Deactivate: the customer cannot sign in and their sessions end.
Activate a deactivated customer.

get.summary: List coupons.

post.summary: Create a coupon (percentage or fixed, minimum order, dates, usage limit).

get.summary: One coupon.

put.summary: Change a coupon (the code stays).

delete.summary: Delete a coupon that was never used; otherwise switch it off.

get.summary: Delivery zones with their rates, weight slabs, areas and countries.

post.summary: Add a zone (rates are set afterwards).

get.summary: One zone.

put.summary: Change a zone's name, status, fallback flag and estimated days.

delete.summary: Delete a zone that is neither the fallback nor used by a country.

put.summary: Set base fee, weight slabs, per-extra-kg fee, free-delivery threshold, remote surcharge and the maximum parcel weight.
Set the districts (and upazila overrides) of a domestic zone; a district moves here from any other zone.

get.summary: All countries, enabled or not.

post.summary: Add a country.

put.summary: Enable or disable a country and choose the international zone that prices it.

post.summary: Add upazilas the loaded dataset lacks (existing names in a district are skipped).

Live checkout totals for the cart and an address: items, coupon, delivery charge, grand total (prices include tax), advance for large cash on delivery orders, payment methods, whether an OTP is needed.

Place the order from the cart. Guest (a mobile number is enough) or signed-in customer. Totals are recalculated; stock is reserved; the answer holds the order number and a tracking token (shown once). Send Idempotency-Key to make retries safe.
Track an order by order number and mobile number, or by tracking token. Anything that does not match answers 404.

get.summary: Same as the POST form, for tracking links (?number=&mobile= or ?token=).
My orders, newest first. filter: active, delivered, cancelled, returned.
One of my orders with items, amounts, the three statuses and the timeline.

post.summary: Cancel my order while it is still in the shop (before courier pickup). Reserved stock goes back at once.

get.summary: Orders of the branches where you may view orders. Filters: the three status tracks, branch, source, fraud state, held, date range; search by number, mobile or name; sort placedAt (default newest), total, number, status.
One order: items, addresses, amounts, three tracks, full timeline, notes, risk flags, fraud log, customer history and the statuses it may move to.

post.summary: Confirm an order. Refused while it is held for a fraud review, while an online payment is pending, or (advanceReceived = false) when an advance is required.
Pack a confirmed order. With the default setting the reserved stock leaves the shelf now (Inventory.DeductAt).
Cancel an order that is Placed, Confirmed or Packed, with a reason. Stock is released (or returned to the shelf when already packed).
Record a delivery step: HandedToCourier, InTransit, OutForDelivery, Delivered, DeliveryFailed, ReturnInProgress, Returned. Only moves the state machine allows (couriers drive this in Step 10).
Add an internal note (staff only) or a customer-visible note.
Move an order to another fulfilling branch before packing: the reservation is released here and taken there (the other branch must hold every item).

get.summary: The data of the packing slip (the screen prints it).

post.summary: Confirm, cancel or print up to 100 orders. Each order is handled on its own (permission, state, stock); the answer lists success or the error code per order.
Social order desk: create an order for a customer found by mobile (Facebook, WhatsApp, phone, walk-in). Items by SKU or variant; discount and delivery override need their own permissions.

Social order desk preview: the same checks and prices as creating the order (coupon, delivery charge, discount and override permissions, stock in the branch), nothing saved or reserved. The totals equal the order that create makes.

get.summary: Orders and value per source in a period (the owner's daily count).
The review queue: orders held for review (Flagged, InReview, AdvanceRequested), riskiest first, with their flags and the customer's history.

post.summary: Decide a held order: Approve, RequestAdvance, Call (note) or Reject (reason; cancels the order). Logged with the staff name.

get.summary: Order history of a customer: delivered, cancelled, returned or failed, spend, history score.
Blocked mobile numbers, e-mails, address texts and devices.

post.summary: Block a mobile, e-mail, address text or device.

delete.summary: Remove an entry (who and when stay in the audit log).

get.summary: The fraud rules with their switch, threshold and action.

put.summary: Switch a rule on or off, set its threshold and its action (Flag, Hold, RequireAdvance, Reject).

get.summary: What of my order can still be returned: the deadline, the quantity left per line (non-returnable items and what is already in a return are excluded), the refund per unit, the list of reasons.

post.summary: Upload one picture of the item (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at least 1000 px on the long side, at most 10 MB). Send the returned path in the return request (up to 5).
Ask for a return or an exchange of delivered items within the return window: lines with quantities, a reason, optional details and pictures. Send Idempotency-Key to make retries safe.

get.summary: My returns, newest first. filter: active, closed.
One of my returns with lines, pictures, the refund amounts, pickup details and a timeline.

post.summary: Cancel my return while it is Requested or Approved.

get.summary: The return queue of the branches where you may view returns. Filters: status, kind, fault, branch, date range; search by return number, order number, mobile or name; sort requestedAt (default newest), number, status.
Counts for the dashboard: returns waiting for approval, pickup, inspection, refund or exchange, and the money refunded this month.
One return: lines with the refund of each, pictures, pickup, the refund breakdown, the order's tracks, notes, the timeline and the statuses it may move to.

post.summary: Approve a requested return. The order moves from Delivered to ReturnInProgress.
Reject a requested return with a reason the customer will see.
Arrange the pickup of an approved return: date, courier, note.
The courier collected the parcel from the customer.
The parcel arrived at the branch.

Record what was found per line (condition, back on the shelf yes or no, refund accepted) and who is at fault. Good items go back into the branch stock with a stock movement; the refund amount is fixed here.

Record the refund of an inspected return: method, reference and (optionally) the amount, which must match the server's figure. The order's payment becomes PartiallyRefunded or Refunded; the money itself is moved by staff (the gateway refund comes with Step 9).
Complete an inspected exchange: a linked zero-value order is placed for the replacement variants and its stock reserved. Refused when a replacement is out of stock.
After inspection: nothing is refunded or exchanged (for example the item was used or damaged by the customer), with a reason.
Add an internal note (staff only).

Approve or reject up to 100 returns. Each one is handled on its own (permission, branch, state); the answer lists success or the error code per return. Rejecting also needs the reject permission, checked per return.

get.summary: The payment methods the shop offers (country and amount decide whether each is available, with the reason when not). For the checkout page.

post.summary: Start (or resume) the online payment of an order: identify it by orderId or orderNumber plus the tracking token (or sign in as its owner). The answer holds redirectUrl, where to send the customer, and the payment id to follow.

get.summary: Where a payment stands, for polling: payment status, order status and order payment status. Reads the shop's records only (the webhook or the return check changes them).

post.summary: Call this when the browser returns from the gateway page. The shop asks the gateway server to server and only a confirmed success makes the payment Paid; nothing in the return URL is trusted.
Report a bank or mobile transfer: the transaction id (and who paid). The payment becomes UnderReview until staff approve or reject it.
Attach a screenshot or receipt (JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB) to a manual transfer that is waiting for review.

Gateway webhook (the provider calls this, not the browser). The signature header and the replay window are checked, an event id seen before changes nothing, and a success is verified with the gateway before the payment becomes Paid.

get.summary: Sandbox gateway only: the payment session behind a sandbox pay page.

post.summary: Sandbox gateway only: what the customer chose on the pay page (success, fail or cancel). The sandbox sends the shop a signed webhook (unless sendWebhook is false) and answers with the returnUrl to send the browser to.

get.summary: Payments of the branches where you may view payments. Filters: status (UnderReview is the manual-transfer queue), method, kind, branch, date range; search by order number, transfer reference or gateway transaction id.
One payment with its append-only events, its refunds and the actions that are open (approve, reject, refund, settle).
The payments of one order.

post.summary: The transfer was checked and the money is there: the payment becomes Paid (and the order is confirmed when the setting is on).
The transfer could not be verified: the payment is Rejected and the order is cancelled (stock released).
Record an advance received for a large cash-on-delivery order. Once it covers the required advance the order can be confirmed without the advanceReceived flag.
Record the cash the courier collected (amount must equal the total minus any advance) with the courier receipt reference.
The courier handed the collected cash to the shop: the payment and the order's payment track become Settled.

get.summary: Money in and out for a period (default: this month), per method, with cash not yet settled, transfers under review and refunds still pending. Branch filter for consolidated or single-branch views.
Refunds, newest first. Filters: status (Pending are waiting to be completed), branch, order, dates.

post.summary: Refund part or all of a payment. Mode Gateway sends it through the gateway at once; mode Manual stays Pending until staff complete it with the transfer reference. The refund can never exceed what was paid.
Finish a Pending refund: the money was sent (reference required). The payment status, the order's payment track and a gap-free credit note follow.
A Pending refund did not happen: the money is refundable again.

get.summary: Payment methods (switched on or off, available or not and why), the cash-on-delivery limit, the transfer instructions and the auto-confirm setting.

put.summary: Switch methods on or off, set the cash-on-delivery limit (0 = none), the account details customers see for transfers, and whether paid orders confirm themselves.

get.summary: Tax rules. The seeded 15% VAT sample is inactive and unverified. Prices are tax-inclusive, so a rule only reports the tax inside the price.

post.summary: Create a tax rule (inclusive only).

put.summary: Change a rule's name, rate, scope, verified flag and note. Orders already placed keep the rate they were placed under.

post.summary: Make this the active rule (any other becomes inactive). An unverified rule needs acknowledgeUnverified = true.
Switch the rule off: new orders then carry no tax breakdown.

get.summary: Invoices of the branches where you may view them; search by number, order number, mobile or name.
One invoice: seller, customer, lines with tax, totals, current payment status and the credit notes issued against it. Invoices never change once issued.
The invoice as an A4 PDF (lang = en or bn).

post.summary: Issue the invoice of a confirmed order, or return the one that exists (it is also issued automatically when the order is confirmed). One invoice per order, numbered gap-free per branch.

get.summary: Credit notes: one is issued for every completed refund.
One credit note.
The credit note as an A4 PDF.
The invoice of one of my orders (issued when the order is confirmed).
The invoice of one of my orders as a PDF (lang = en or bn).
The invoice of an order for a guest: order number plus the tracking token shown at checkout. Anything that does not match answers 404.
The invoice PDF for a guest (same identification).
The couriers with their rates, priority, switches and how many parcels are with each. Credentials are never shown (they are not stored here).

post.summary: Add a courier. The adapter must exist; a courier whose adapter is not set up cannot be switched on. Secret-like settings are refused.

get.summary: The adapters the system has (the sandbox and the six real companies) and whether each is set up.
One courier.

put.summary: Change a courier: name, adapter, priority, weight and zone limits, cash on delivery, the customer charge override (first switched-on courier only) and the rates the courier charges the shop.

delete.summary: Archive a courier (never erased). Refused while parcels are with it.

put.summary: Switch a courier on or off. A courier whose adapter is not set up (COURIER.NOT_CONFIGURED) cannot be switched on.

get.summary: Settlement batches of the branches where you may view cash on delivery. Filters: status, courier, branch; search by number or reference.

post.summary: Make a batch of a courier's delivered cash on delivery parcels in one branch (all waiting ones, or the shipmentIds you give). Gap-free number CS-BRANCH-YYMM-000001.

get.summary: The delivered cash on delivery parcels of a courier that are in no batch yet (what a new batch would hold).
One batch with every parcel: expected, received, difference (negative is short, positive is over) and the note.

post.summary: Enter what the courier really paid per parcel (a parcel left out counts as paid in full). A short or over parcel needs a note. Can be repeated until the batch is settled.
Close a reconciled batch with the deposit reference: every order's cash becomes Settled (payment record and order payment track), the differences stay on the batch.
Drop an open or reconciled batch; its parcels can go into another one.

get.summary: Parcels of the branches where you may view shipments. Filters: status, courier, branch, kind (Forward or Return), order, cash on delivery only, open only, booking date range; search by consignment, order number, recipient name or phone; sort bookedAt (default newest), status, order.
One parcel with its pickup and delivery addresses, cash to collect, attempts, failure reason, the next statuses it may reach and every event (raw status, our status, source).
The immutable event log of a parcel, oldest first.
The data of the parcel label: barcode text, both addresses, weight, cash to collect and item count. The screen prints it. Records that a label was printed.
The couriers checked against an order: the ones that can take it first (the first is recommended: priority, then cost), then the ones that cannot with the reason.

post.summary: Book a packed order with a courier (the suggested one unless courierId is given). The parcel carries the fulfilling branch's pickup address and the cash to collect; the order stays Packed until the courier reports pickup.
Book up to 50 packed orders, each with its suggested courier (or one courier for all). Each order is handled on its own; the answer lists the consignment or the error code per order.
Cancel a booking the courier has not picked up (reason required). The courier is told. The order stays Packed and can be booked again.
Cancel a booked (not yet picked up) parcel and book the order again, with the same or another courier.

Sandbox courier only: move the parcel along (without a status, the next step: picked up, in transit, out for delivery, delivered; or give picked_up, in_transit, at_hub, out_for_delivery, delivered, delivery_failed, returned). Goes through the same path as a webhook.

Courier webhook (the courier calls this, not the browser). The signature header (Juvo-Signature: t=unix,v1=hmac) and the 5 minute replay window are checked, an event id seen before changes nothing (status duplicate), and a parcel we do not know is acknowledged as ignored.
A short-lived token for the real-time hub, for the signed-in staff member or customer (call it from the BFF with the access token, then connect the browser to the hub path with it).
A short-lived hub token for ONE order, for a guest who proves it with the tracking token or order number plus mobile. It cannot follow any other order.

Cancel an order from the tracking page (no sign-in): prove it with the order number plus mobile, or the tracking token. Only while it is Placed, Confirmed or Packed (ORDER.CANNOT_CANCEL after). Rate limited.

get.summary: Every message template (code, channel, language) with its text, version and the placeholders it may use. Built-in texts show version 0 until staff edit them.

put.summary: Edit a template text (a new version; the old text is kept). Unknown placeholders are refused. isActive = false switches the message off for that channel and language.

get.summary: The versions of a template, newest first (version 0 is the built-in text).

post.summary: Render a template (the text in the request, or the current one) with sample values and report unknown placeholders.

get.summary: The delivery log, newest first. Filters: status (Pending, Sent, Failed, DeadLetter, Skipped), channel, template code or prefix, recipient, dates.
One logged message with its attempts and last error.

post.summary: Send a failed or dead-lettered message again (back to Pending with a fresh attempt count).

get.summary: Which channels are switched on and the default message language.

put.summary: Switch SMS, email and WhatsApp on or off and set the default language (en or bn).
Choose the language (en or bn) of the messages the shop sends me.
